power.supply: Input: 100 – 240 V AC, 50/60 Hz, 1.5 A; Output: 48 V DC, 1 A (power adapter)

features: H.264 recording, concurrent 720p HD recording for all channels at 30 fps
Display output resolutions: 1920 x 1080, 1280 x 1024, 1280 x 720, 1024 x 758 at 60 Hz
Network protocols: IPv4, IPv6, UDP, TCP, ICMP, ONVIF v2.2, DHCP, NTP, DNS, DDNS, SMTP, FTP, HTTP, UPnP, RTSP, RTP, RTCP
Live view: single camera or quad view
Camera management: OSD, image quality, PTZ, motion detection, privacy masks, video tamper detection, video loss detection
notes: Consumption of 50 W is stated with HDD and maximum PoE load.
TV-NVR104D2 is the same NVR with a pre-installed 2 TB HDD.

Maximum single-camera recording resolution differs between sources: the TV-NVR104 datasheet states recording up to 720p; the TV-NVR104D2 datasheet states 1080p maximum for a single camera. max_camera_mp left out.
Uplink speed differs between sources: the specifications list a 10/100 Mbps network port; the TV-NVR104D2 datasheet feature section names a Gigabit Ethernet uplink port. ethernet_speed_mbps left out.
Dimensions and weight differ between sources: 199 x 199 x 47 mm and 584 g (TV-NVR104) vs 205 x 198 x 45 mm and 1.3 kg (TV-NVR104D2 with 2 TB HDD). Both left out.
Hardware versions v1.0R and v1.1R exist. The v1.1R datasheets do not list ONVIF; the v1.0R datasheets and both product pages list ONVIF v2.2.
Also sold as kit TV-NVR104K (TV-NVR104 with pre-installed 1 TB HDD and two TV-IP320PI cameras).
